Record Class PaginationDto

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.jwcarman.jpa.pagination.PaginationDto
Record Components:
pageIndex - The index of the page
pageSize - The size of the page
totalElementCount - The total number of elements to be paginated
totalPageCount - The total number of pages
hasNext - Whether there is a next page
hasPrevious - Whether there is a previous page
public record PaginationDto(int pageIndex, int pageSize, long totalElementCount, long totalPageCount, boolean hasNext, boolean hasPrevious) extends Record
A DTO representing pagination information.

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with the compare method from their corresponding wrapper classes.
      Specified by:
      equals in class Record
      Parameters:
      o - the object with which to compare
      Returns:
      true if this object is the same as the o argument; false otherwise.
